proposed_policy.future_trials: When task requires structured JSON, explicitly demand exactly one top-level object, required keys/types, no prose/code fences, empty result inside its named field. Treat unambiguous violation as format failure only after this policy is fixed before execution.
proposed_policy.historical_trials: Preserve original prompt/trace/grade. Do not retroactively relabel all 12 as failures. Regrade separately under an explicit versioned policy after raw records are received.
LLM_scope: Semantic adequacy/grounding/appropriate completion and result classification/first-failure stage where rules cannot decide.
No override of definite numeric/set/value failures, forbidden writes, approval rules, exact write counts or missing trusted runtime context.
proposed_policy.no_silent_normalization: Do not strip prose/fences, coerce number/string, guess missing fields or wrap [] into a guessed key without a declared policy.
proposed_policy.format_vs_result_class: A format violation prevents task success, but does not by itself prove a wrong factual assertion. Keep fact correctness, format and result-class/undecidable diagnosis distinct.
